integrity: Proof supplies full mathematical implication; finite code checks only corroborate it. Earlier controller recursions, chi-square distributions and large-deviation principles are acknowledged as known components.
scientific_limitations: Conditional single-step distribution, not long-run adaptive integration convergence or accuracy.
Linear additive isotropic Gaussian OU model; fixed positive tolerance and common predictor-corrector Brownian increment.
Unbounded raw PI proposal only has divergent higher moments; implemented clipped factor is bounded.
Bibliographic uniqueness is not independently established.
title: Exact clipping and moment laws for Gaussian Euler–Heun PI step control
